column2: AgriTrace
column5: A blockchain-based system for tracking agricultural products from farmers to consumers, providing transparent and tamper-resistant information about the product’s origin, processing, transportation, and distribution.

TenderSeal – Blockchain-Based Sealed-Bid Integrity for Public Procurement
column5: A smart-contract system that secures the sealed-bid window of public procurement, from bid submission to bid opening. Registered bidders submit salted cryptographic commitments together with a bid-security deposit before an on-chain deadline. Bids are revealed and verified only after the deadline, the lowest responsive bid is selected automatically, and bidders who fail to reveal forfeit their deposit. This prevents insiders from reading bids early, accepting late or backdated bids, or altering bids after opening, without having to trust the procurement platform operator.

column2: SecureOTA - Blockchain-Anchored Firmware Update Integrity for IoT Devices
column4: IoT Security / Software Supply Chain Integrity
column5: A blockchain-based system that anchors cryptographic fingerprints of IoT firmware releases on a public ledger, allowing embedded devices to independently verify the authenticity and integrity of an over-the-air (OTA) update before installing it. preventing tampered-binary injection, rollback to known-vulnerable versions, and continued use of revoked firmware.

column2: Blockchain-Based Donation Tracking System
column5: This project proposes a blockchain-based donation tracking platform that lets donors contribute funds to a registered campaign or NGO and independently verify, on a public ledger, that their contribution was received and released only against verified milestones.

column2: CertiChain - Blockchain-Based Academic Certificate Verification System
column5: A blockchain-based system to issue, store, and verify academic certificates as tamper-proof digital records, preventing forgery and enabling instant third-party verification without contacting the issuing institution.

column2: Blockchain-Based AI Model Provenance and Integrity Verification
column5: A blockchain-based system that allows authorized AI model developers to register cryptographic hashes, version information, publisher details, and provenance metadata of released AI models. Users can verify that a downloaded or deployed model matches the authentic registered version, view its version history, and detect modified, unauthorized, or revoked model files. The actual AI models remain off-chain, while only their hashes and provenance records are stored on the blockchain.

column2: Blockchain-Based Vehicle History Record System (Anti-Odometer Fraud)
column5: A tamper-proof record of used-vehicle history. Service centres, insurers and the RMV record mileage, accidents and ownership transfers against the chassis number. Mileage rollback is detected automatically, and buyers can verify a vehicle's history.

column2: Smart Contract for Secure Fund Escrow
column5: A blockchain based escrow system built on Ethereum that securely holds a buyer's funds in a smart contract and releases them to the seller only upon confirmed delivery. If a dispute arises, an arbiter resolves it on-chain. A timeout mechanism prevents funds from being locked indefinitely. The system eliminates the need for a trusted third-party intermediary by leveraging the transparency and immutability of smart contracts.

column2: TicketChain
column5: A blockchain-based system for issuing and verifying event tickets using tamper-resistant blockchain records to prevent forged and duplicate tickets.

column2: Counterfeit Medicine Checker
column5: Blockchain-based medicine authenticity verification: an Ethereum smart contract records each medicine pack as it is made by the manufacturer, approved by the NMRA, and passed to the distributor and then the pharmacy. Patients scan the pack's QR code to see if it is genuine, already sold (copied code), recalled, expired or fake.

column2: SkillSeal – Blockchain-Based Vocational & Professional Training Certificate Verification
column5: A smart-contract system that lets authorized training institutes and professional bodies issue certificates (for example safety, trade or technical certifications) by recording only the SHA-256 hash of the certificate file on Ethereum. The file itself stays off-chain. Employers and inspectors verify a certificate by re-hashing their copy and checking it against the chain. Any change to the file makes verification fail. Only wallets authorized by the owner can issue. Certificates can be revoked (for example if issued by mistake or later withdrawn) while the record and audit trail stay on-chain.

column2: MediaChain – Decentralized Digital Asset IP & Copyright Timestamping
column5: A blockchain-based system for creators, designers, and developers to establish undeniable proof of prior art and copyright ownership. Cryptographic signatures and version histories of digital assets (designs, code, audio, media) are anchored on-chain at creation, allowing creators to instantly prove original authorship and detect unauthorized tampering or stolen copies without relying on centralized copyright offices.

column2: Anti-Counterfeit Product Verification via NFTs
column5: A blockchain-based decentralized application where manufacturers mint unique NFTs for physical products at creation. Consumers can scan a QR code to query the smart contract, instantly verifying the product's authenticity, manufacturing metadata (serial number, batch ID), and ownership history to combat counterfeit goods.

column2: AgentTrust
column5: Reputation-Gated, Validation-Triggered Escrow for Autonomous AI-Agent Payments

column2: RentTrust
column5: Blockchain-based rental deposit management and dispute resolution system using smart contracts for secure deposit handling, transparent agreements, and fair settlement between landlords and tenants.

column2: LandChain – Blockchain-Based Land Ownership Registry
column5: A blockchain-based land registry where the Land Registry office records land parcels as tamper-proof records on Ethereum. Ownership transfers must be requested by the current owner and approved by the registrar, which prevents forged deeds and double-selling of the same land. Buyers and banks can instantly verify the true owner and the full ownership history before a purchase.

column2: UniLedger – Blockchain-Based Certificate Verification System
column5: A blockchain-based decentralized application for issuing and verifying academic certificates. The system generates a SHA-256 hash of the certificate off-chain and stores it on an Ethereum smart contract. Employers can instantly verify the document's authenticity and detect tampering by querying the immutable on-chain record.

column2: EvidenceChain – Blockchain-Based Digital Forensic Evidence Integrity & Chain-of-Custody System
column4: digital forensics / incident response (cyber security) and blockchain integrity verification
column5: A blockchain-based evidence management system where investigators record digital evidence (files, logs, images) as tamper-proof hash records on Ethereum. Custody transfers must be logged by the current holder and confirmed by the receiving party, which prevents undetected tampering and disputes over who handled the evidence and when. Courts and auditors can instantly verify that evidence is unaltered and review its complete custody history before it's admitted as proof.

column2: ThreatChain – Decentralized Cyber Threat Intelligence & Malware Hash Registry
column4: Incident Response, Malware Defense & Threat Intelligence (IoC Sharing)
column5: ThreatChain is a decentralized Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) platform that uses blockchain technology to maintain a tamper-proof, globally synchronized registry of malicious Indicators of Compromise (IoCs).

column2: GuardianVault – Smart-Contract Wallet with Guardian-Assisted Recovery
column4:
Blockchain Security / Wallet Access Control and 
Recovery
column5: An Ethereum smart-contract wallet that enables recovery of wallet control after owner-key loss through approval from two of three guardians, a waiting period, and acceptance by the new owner. It supports cancellation by the current owner and uses test cryptocurrency to demonstrate recovery and rejection of unauthorized attempts.

column2: Software License Verification System
column4: Software Licensing / Digital Rights Management (DRM) / Software Asset Management
column5: A blockchain-based platform for issuing, managing, transferring, revoking, and verifying software licenses.

column2: GreenLedger – Blockchain-Based Renewable Energy Certificate Tracking System
column5: A blockchain-based system for issuing, transferring, and retiring Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) representing verified renewable electricity generation. Authorized issuers create certificates for verified generation, certificate owners can transfer them, and smart contracts prevent retired certificates from being transferred or reused, helping prevent double counting while providing a transparent and tamper-resistant ownership history.

column2: Decentralized Key Recovery using Shamir's Secret Sharing
column5: Create a smart contract based system that lets a user recover a lost private key through a group of trusted guardians. The key is split into 5 pieces using Shamir's Secret Sharing, and the blockchain enforces the rules: at least 3 guardians must approve, and a waiting period lets the owner cancel a fake recovery.

column2: BugBountyChain -  Decentralized Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Disclosure Platform
column5: A decentralized vulnerability disclosure and escrow-backed payout system for ethical hackers and open-source project maintainers.

column2: ExamVault-Blockchain-Based Examination Paper Integrity & Controlled Release System
column5: A blockchain-based system that protects the integrity of university examination papers. A cryptographic hash of an approved exam paper is recorded on the blockchain along with its exam ID, version, approval timestamp, and scheduled release time. The actual exam paper is encrypted and stored off-chain. Before release, the system recalculates and compares the paper's hash with the blockchain record to detect unauthorized modification or replacement, while maintaining a tamper-resistant audit trail of submission, approval, and release.
